title: Vessel drafts: AI-proposed great-vessel outlines and levels (unreviewed)
description: UNREVIEWED AI DRAFTS by Horalix for the five great vessels of the superior mediastinum (both brachiocephalic veins, brachiocephalic trunk, left common carotid, left subclavian) plus context structures, and AI-derived five-vessel / aortic-arch slice intervals, on contrast-enhanced chest CTs of the body and chest-pairs pack(s). Contains no images: every target references series and SOP Instance UIDs of those packs. Nothing here has been checked by a radiologist.
